The DICOM test files in this directory (emri_small.dcm, color-pl.dcm, CR1_6154.dcm) are sourced from the open-source pydicom project (pydicom and pydicom-data, https://github.com/pydicom/pydicom).

The fixtures are distributed within pydicom under the repository's MIT licensing terms. For CR1_6154.dcm, the underlying anonymized scan originates from the Patient Contributed Image Repository (pcir.org), released into the public domain by voluntary contributor consent, and downsized to 16x16 by pydicom maintainers for test suite distribution. No additional redistribution restrictions apply.
